SflapARe! mahAvrata! saMSayo me mahAn jAtastanme vyAKyAtumarhasi । kimarTaM te lalAwe vE tftIyaM netramutTitam । kimarTaYca girirdagDaH sapakzigaRakAnanaH । kimarTaYca punardeva! prakftisTastvayA kftaH । taTEva drumasaMcCannaH kfto'yaM tu pitA mama” maheSvara uvAca । “netre me saMvfte devi! tvayA bAlyAdanindite । nazwAlokastaTA lokaH kzaRena samapadyata । nazwAditye taTA loke tamoBUte nagAtmaje! । tftIyaM locanaM dIptaM sfzwaM me rakzatA prajAH । tasya cAkzRo mahattejo yenAyaM maTito giriH । tvatpriyArTacca me devi! prakftisTaH punaH kftaH” । durgAyAH trinayanASabdavAcyatve heturdevIpu॰ 45 a॰ ukto yaTA “pakziRAM cottaraM lokaM taTA brahmAyanaM param । nayaM sammArgaDarmatvaM dfzwO trinayanA matA” devIpu॰ 45 a॰ । “paYcavaktraM trinetram” SivaDyAnam । “nijatrinetratvAvataratvaboDikAm” nEza॰ sADyagaRaBedAnAM trinetratvaM matsyapu॰ uktaM yaTA “tataH sADyagaRAnISastrinetrAnasfsft pujaH । kowayaScaturaSItirjarAmaraRavarjitAH । kAmaM sfjannamartyAMstAn brahmaRA vinivAritaH । nEvaM viDA Bavet sfzwirjarAmaraRavarjitA” ।
